children: The FTSE 100 rose around 0.5% on Friday, led by strong gains among mining stocks.
Glencore climbed more than 3%, while Anglo American gained nearly 3%, and Antofagasta and Fresnillo advanced more than 2% each.
United Utilities added 0.6% after the water company said its operational performance remained in line with expectations and that it was seeking support for £1 billion of investment in its network.
Oil majors moved in the opposite direction, with BP falling more than 2% and Shell down over 1%.

Oil prices declined as markets weighed the possibility of a US-Iran truce against concerns that intensifying Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia could disrupt supplies from the key Middle Eastern producer.
On the data front, UK consumer confidence improved for a third consecutive month, according to GfK, although the survey continued to highlight persistent caution among households.
The FTSE 100 was up around 0.7% for the week.

title: FTSE 100 Rises on Friday
